description: This source file defines an Android Activity class 'SecureView' demonstrating different methods to secure views against touch spoofing attacks. It sets up buttons with different security filtering approaches and displays overlays with Toasts.

classes.name: SecureView
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating view security against touch spoofing, with three buttons showing different security behaviors, including overlay display and touch filtering.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up buttons and their click/touch behaviors.

methods.name: showOverlay
methods.description: Creates and displays a custom overlay toast to demonstrate overlaying the activity.

methods.name: setClickedAction
methods.description: Assigns a click listener to a button that shows a dialog with a message.

methods.name: setTouchFilter
methods.description: Sets a touch listener on a button to filter touch events if the window is obscured.
